sourceText:
Super Healthy S'Mores!
By: Adam Paul Green
Published: Wednesday, July 18, 2012 - 1:20pm

Ingredients




2 squares graham cracker
2 chunks dark chocolate (Xocai XoBiotic Squares)
1 large marshmallow

Preparation

1 Place 1 graham cracker on a plate; place XoBiotic Squares on top. Place marshmallow on top of the two XoBiotic Squares, then put int he microwave for about 8 seconds or long enough that you see the bottom start to bulge outwards. Remove and quickly place the other graham cracker on top of the marshmallow, gently compressing it until the marshmallow spaces out. Serves 1
